definition.zh-TW: 為了買設備、無形資產等長期資產付出的現金，也就是一般說的資本支出。數字越大表示公司投入越多在未來的產能。
definition.en: Cash paid to buy equipment, intangible assets and other long-term assets, commonly called capital expenditure. A larger figure means more investment in future capacity.
